Event

Wealth from All Sides: Bazaar Mania

A rare money tree appeared at the village entrance. You took the chance to start a bustling bazaar, unaware that a mysterious woman had set her eyes on you...

Activity TypeGveCoinFightPhases1Duration7 or 8 days

Across all phases

Core Rewards

LinlangFellow · LinlangFigure [Harvest Day M]Player Costume · Harvest Day (M)Figure [Harvest Day F]Player Costume · Harvest Day (F)
GameplayEvent Rules3 sections
Basic Gameplay

◆ Transcenders can build and upgrade stalls in the bazaar. Once built, stalls produce Bazaar Gold Coins. Increasing stall levels boosts the coin production rate.

◆ As the total level of all stalls increases, you can advance the rank of the Money Tree in the bazaar center to earn advancement rewards.

◆ Upgrading stalls requires Bazaar Gold Coins. Besides collecting coins from stalls, you can also obtain them by making offerings to the Goddess of Wealth.

◆ Each stall has a storage limit for produced coins. Do not forget to claim them regularly.

Goddess Offerings

◆ Spend Offering Gems to make offerings to the goddess. Each offering triggers a random event and grants bazaar gold coins.

◆ Each offering also grants points. Accumulate points to claim bonus rewards.

◆ Offering Gems restore over time or can be replenished using specific recovery items.

Leaderboard and Rewards

◆ The event features both overall rankings and daily rankings.

◆ Daily rankings are based on the number of Offering Gems used daily by individual players and guilds.

◆ Overall rankings are finalized at the end of the event and are based on the fastest Earning Rate achieved by individual players and guilds.

◆ When leaderboard results are finalized, you can claim rewards based on your ranking position.

◆ Any unclaimed rewards will be delivered via the in-game mail.
